name: Harem Nante Aru Wake Nai Janai Desu ka
original_name: ハーレムなんてあるわけないじゃないですか
source:
This is a romance game that starts with a lazy princess trying to build a harem.
Try to visit different places in the castle and bond with them in order to recruit them into your harem.
Though, eventually, you may get involved in something suspicious or get into a lot of trouble...

[From [url=https://ragexxxx.itch.io/harem]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一款恋爱游戏，故事从一位懒散公主试图建立后宫开始。
试着前往城堡各处，与大家增进感情，将他们招入自己的后宫吧。
不过，最终你或许会卷入可疑的事件，或惹上一大堆麻烦……

[摘自[url=https://ragexxxx.itch.io/harem]itch.io[/url]]
